mechanism: loop-carried state propagation (the reset of a continuation encoding is masked by a later re-write of the same state variable)

target_operation.note: resets the carried RFC 2231 continuation encoding when a non-continuation piece is parsed

deletion_method: replace the target line with an equal-indentation 'pass  # P-: target A deleted' (benchmark_real_v3.run_suite.delete_line); line numbers are preserved
test_scope: Werkzeug 2.2.3 released tests/ suite with 24 dev_server tests protocol-deselected; P+ applicable suite 816 passed, 24 deselected; 31 original tests execute A

candidate_universe.role: later write of the same loop-carried state; overwrites the reset before the next read

universe_notes: A and U are the only writes to continued_encoding inside the option loop; the initialization at line 429 runs once before the loop and is not an alternative supplier.
Line 443 reads the state; it does not write it and therefore cannot mask A.
Masking is cross-iteration: a prior continuation supplies an encoding, A resets it, and U re-supplies an encoding before the next continuation reads the state.
Completeness outside the declared U is not claimed.

inputs.note: The non-continuation piece 'foo=bar' resets the carried UTF-8 encoding in P+. P- keeps it, so the last continuation is percent-decoded instead of left raw.
After the reset, the explicit encoding on 'size*0*' re-writes the same state. P+ and P- both decode the final continuation as UTF-8; disabling that re-write exposes the missing reset.

not_claimed: All RFC 2231/5987 header forms and malformed inputs
